editorial:
Imagine you are spending a quiet few days in the countryside with your mom, only to have a giant, talking bird show up and tell you that you are about to die. That is exactly what happens to the teenage girl in this story. It starts off feeling like a normal family drama about a mother and daughter who do not always get along, but it quickly turns into something much weirder. The vibe is very calm and a bit sad, but the presence of the bird keeps you wondering what will happen next. You really feel the tension as the characters try to figure out how to handle the news that their time is running out.

The acting is the best part here, as the bond between the lead actresses feels totally real. While the story moves slowly, it gives you time to really care about the characters. Some people might find the pace a bit too sluggish, but if you like emotional stories, you will love it.
endingExplained: In the end, the daughter accepts that she cannot escape her fate. The bird, who represents Death, helps her find peace with her mother. Instead of fighting the inevitable, they spend their final moments sharing love and honesty. The movie wraps up with a quiet, emotional goodbye, showing that while death is scary, saying goodbye with love is what truly matters. It ends on a bittersweet note that leaves you thinking about your own family.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves heartfelt stories about family and life
